title: Redeem a Tikka at the counter
summary: Check a customer's code and mark it used. It takes a few seconds.

steps.title: Open Redeem
steps.body: Tap Redeem in the bar at the bottom of your phone. Staff go straight to it when they sign in.

steps.title: Scan or type the code
steps.body:
Tap "Turn on camera" and scan the QR on their Tikka, or type the code they show you, like GS-7X4QP.

Checking never uses the code. It's only used when you confirm.

steps.title: Check what they get
steps.body:
You see their first name, what they get, the tier and when it ends. If you see "Only if", check the condition first, like "With any paid service". "Planned" shows the day they said they'd come in.

If it's an action Tikka, like "Follow us on Instagram", tick the box once they've done it.

steps.title: Check their WhatsApp (if asked)
steps.body:
If you see "Check their WhatsApp first", ask them to open WhatsApp, go to Settings and tap their name. Read the number on their profile yourself (not a screenshot, and not what they tell you), and type the last 4 digits.

If it doesn't match, don't give the reward. They can come back with the phone they claimed with. You get 3 tries a day, and nothing is used.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.body: Tap New customer or Been here before, and add how much they spent if you like (it shows you what each drop brought in). Then tap "Confirm redemption".

tips: If it says a code has a typo, check it with the customer. Codes never use 0, O, 1, I or L, so they're easy to read.
A code can only be used once. If it was already used, Redeem tells you when.
Busy? Tap "Not now, scan another code". Nothing is used until you confirm.
